anomalies.description: A man (Will Smith) fires a handgun; a bright muzzle flash is visible at frame f6, and the gun is clearly aimed and discharged in frames f5–f6.; A man fires a handgun; a bright muzzle flash is visible at the barrel, confirming discharge.
A large, sudden explosion occurs on the bridge, engulfing the area in fire and smoke; visible as intense white/yellow flash at f9, rapidly expanding fireball at f10–f12.
A man (Will Smith) is shown aiming and firing a handgun; muzzle flash is visible at frame f5, and recoil/face reaction at f6 confirms discharge.
A massive, sudden fireball erupts from the ground near a classic muscle car, engulfing the vehicle in flames and smoke; the initial blast is extremely bright and expands rapidly.
Two metal barrels erupt in a sudden, intense fireball with rapid expansion of flames and smoke, consistent with a deflagration or explosion.
A large, sudden fireball erupts from a vehicle or object on the road, producing a rapidly expanding plume of smoke and flame, characteristic of an explosion.

A large, sudden fireball erupts from a vehicle or object on the road, producing a massive plume of smoke and flame that expands rapidly over several seconds.; Sustained, massive fireball engulfing a vehicle, with turbulent flame dynamics indicating ongoing explosive combustion (e.g., fuel tank rupture). The fire intensifies and fully consumes the vehicle structure.

A man (Will Smith) is shown firing a handgun; muzzle flash and recoil are visible in frame f9, and the subsequent underwater shot (f10–f12) shows the immediate aftermath of a bullet impact in water, consistent with a gunshot.

Will Smith aims a handgun directly at the camera; the gun is held steady in a firing posture, consistent with an imminent or ongoing shot.; Two men are engaged in a gun standoff: one points a revolver at the other, who holds a pistol; both weapons are aimed, suggesting active or imminent shooting.
A man in black points a revolver directly at another man's face; muzzle flash and smoke are visible in the close-up (f1), indicating a shot was fired.
The man in the patterned shirt fires a semi-automatic pistol, with visible muzzle flash and recoil; he is shouting, and smoke appears in subsequent frames.
A man and a woman are in close physical contact near a doorway; the man appears to be restraining or grappling the woman, consistent with a struggle or physical confrontation.

The man in the patterned shirt fires again; his face is contorted in a yell, and a bright muzzle flash is visible at the gun’s barrel.; A figure behind a counter is struck by gunfire; debris and smoke erupt around him as he recoils backward, consistent with being hit by a bullet.

In frame f2, a man (Will Smith) is engaged in close physical combat with another individual behind a pillar; both are in direct contact, arms interlocked, and bodies strained. In frame f3, the struggle continues amid rising smoke, confirming ongoing mutual physical combat.
A bright muzzle flash and visible sparks erupt from a firearm inside a dim, smoky room, indicating a shot being fired.

A second distinct muzzle flash, greenish-white and intense, is seen as a person fires a handgun at close range; the flash illuminates the shooter's hands and weapon.; A third muzzle flash and shower of sparks occur inside the same smoky interior, matching the earlier shooting event’s visual signature, suggesting a second shot fired in the same location.

A man (Will Smith) is actively engaged in a physical struggle, using a heavy object (possibly a typewriter or similar device) to smash through a cabinet or wall above him, with papers and debris flying; his facial expression and posture indicate aggressive, forceful action against an unseen opponent or barrier.
A man (Will Smith) is shown in close-up, shouting aggressively with his arm raised and fist clenched, indicating active physical confrontation or imminent assault.
A man in a 'POLICE' shirt holds two handguns pointed outward, with visible muzzle flash and recoil in later frames indicating active firing.

Will Smith aims a handgun at an off-screen target; muzzle flash or bullet impact is not visible, but the sustained aiming posture and facial tension across multiple frames suggest an imminent or ongoing shooting action in a high-stakes confrontation.
Will Smith fires a handgun; muzzle flash is visible at the barrel in frame f3 (37.0s) and sustained recoil/position change in f4 (38.0s), indicating discharge.

A police officer aims a handgun directly at a person with arms extended; muzzle flash or bullet impact is not visible, but the sustained aiming posture across multiple frames (f4–f8) indicates an imminent or ongoing shooting action in a high-tension confrontation.; Will Smith, in a police shirt, aims a handgun at an off-screen target with both hands in a ready-to-fire stance; muzzle flash or bullet impact is not visible, but the posture and context strongly indicate an imminent or ongoing shooting action.
Will Smith again aims a handgun in a similar two-handed stance, consistent with a shooting event; no visible discharge, but the framing and continuity support active engagement.

Will Smith, in a police shirt, aims a handgun directly at the camera; his mouth is open as if shouting or commanding, consistent with an imminent or just-fired shot. No muzzle flash visible, but posture and context strongly indicate active shooting engagement.
Will Smith again aims a handgun forward with intense expression; smoke/haze in background and his open-mouthed command posture suggest active firearm use during a confrontation.
A man in a black 'POLICE' t-shirt is actively aiming and firing a handgun at a group of people; muzzle flash is visible in frames f1–f4 and f8–f9, confirming discharge.

In frame f10 (97.0s), a blurry foreground figure points a firearm toward a person in white; in frames f11–f12 (97.5–98.0s), Will Smith in a police shirt aims a pistol forward with visible muzzle flash or bright light near the barrel, consistent with a discharge. The rapid sequence and weapon orientation support an active shooting event.
A man (Will Smith) is shown in close-up aiming and firing a handgun; muzzle flash is visible at the barrel tip.

A large, sudden fiery explosion erupts on a wooden platform, violently propelling a figure upward and outward amid smoke and debris.; A large, sudden explosion erupts with intense fireball, debris, and sparks; two figures are violently propelled upward from the blast center.; Continuation of the explosion’s aftermath: two individuals are airborne amidst smoke and embers, indicating they were thrown by the blast; no active detonation but clear ballistic motion from prior explosion.

A second distinct explosion occurs: a large cross-shaped structure ignites violently in the background while a helicopter hovers nearby; fire and smoke rise rapidly, consistent with a controlled or triggered detonation.
A man is shown aiming and firing a handgun; muzzle flash is visible in frame f9 (144.5s), confirming active discharge.

A figure in the foreground (f0) holds a long firearm-like object pointed toward the center of the scene; muzzle flash or discharge is not visible, but posture and context suggest aiming/firing action during the initial frames.

A soldier in silhouette fires a rifle, with visible muzzle flash and smoke erupting from the barrel at frame f6 (11.0s) and persisting through f7 (11.5s).; Close-up of a soldier shouting while aiming and firing a rifle; muzzle flash is visible at f8 (12.0s), and the weapon is actively engaged through f10 (13.0s).; Group of soldiers in tactical formation actively firing rifles from behind cover (a wrecked vehicle and wall); multiple muzzle flashes and weapon recoil visible across frames f12–f14.
A soldier in tactical gear is actively firing a rifle; muzzle flash and smoke are visible at the barrel, indicating live gunfire.

A group of soldiers in tactical gear are actively aiming and firing rifles from behind cover (a damaged vehicle) in an urban environment; muzzle flash or recoil is not clearly visible, but the posture, weapon alignment, and synchronized readiness strongly indicate active engagement/shooting.
Soldiers in tactical gear are actively firing weapons from behind cover; muzzle flashes and weapon recoil visible in frames f0–f2.
A soldier fires a rifle with visible muzzle flash and dust/debris displacement; sustained fire observed across frames f5–f7.

A soldier in the foreground is holding a rifle in a ready-to-fire posture; muzzle flash or bullet tracers are not visible, but the context of advancing under fire and the presence of other soldiers taking cover strongly suggest active engagement. In frame f0 (42.5s), the soldier’s stance and weapon orientation indicate imminent or ongoing shooting.

In frames f5–f6 (45.0–45.5s), soldiers are seen moving along a dirt path with weapons raised; by f9 (47.0s), one soldier is actively aiming and appears to be firing from behind cover. The sequence shows coordinated advance under fire, with at least one individual engaging a target.

Frames f11–f14 show soldiers in silhouette against bright backlight, with one soldier standing atop rubble raising a weapon in a clear firing motion (f12–f14). The posture, weapon elevation, and context of sustained movement under fire confirm active shooting. No muzzle flash visible, but the action is unambiguous.

First frame shows a dark object held in hand resembling a handgun pointed forward; however, image is extremely blurry and no muzzle flash, recoil, or bullet trajectory is visible. Evidence is weak but present in f0 only.

A man in military-style gear is holding a rifle in a ready position across multiple frames; though no muzzle flash is visible, his sustained aiming posture and tactical context (ruined interior, low light) strongly suggest active engagement or imminent shooting.
A large, bright explosion erupts near the crashed helicopter and domed building, producing a massive fireball, debris, and shockwave; visible from frame f9 (16.5s) through f12 (18.0s).

Soldiers are seen running through smoke and debris after the explosion; one soldier in frame f6 (18.5s) is holding a rifle in a ready/aimed posture while moving forward, suggesting active engagement or return fire. No muzzle flash is visible, but the context and weapon handling support shooting as an ongoing action during this interval.

Multiple frames (f4–f7) show bright orange fireballs and rapidly expanding smoke plumes on the ground level, consistent with detonations of explosive devices in an urban alleyway; the progression from ignition (f4) to smoke expansion (f7) confirms explosive events.

A soldier in the foreground is holding a rifle and appears to be actively firing, with muzzle flash or bright light visible near the weapon's barrel in frame f12; background soldiers are also in combat stances with weapons raised.; In frame f13, a soldier in the background emits a distinct green muzzle flash while aiming a rifle, indicating active gunfire; other armed personnel are engaged in combat positions.
Green-tinged smoke and debris erupt in a chaotic burst, consistent with an explosive discharge or close-range gunfire; a metallic object (possibly a spent casing) is visible mid-air at f0 and f1.

Visible muzzle flash and smoke rising from a spent cartridge casing in the foreground, indicating recent gunfire; multiple spent casings are scattered and some appear hot/glowing.; Soldier in helmet and goggles is shouting while holding a rifle in a ready position; background shows smoke and debris consistent with ongoing fire; no visible muzzle flash but posture and context strongly suggest active engagement.
Soldier aiming rifle directly forward; bright muzzle flash visible at barrel tip in frame f9, confirming active discharge of weapon.
Soldier in close-up holds rifle in firing stance; slight motion blur and facial tension suggest recoil or imminent shot; no direct muzzle flash but consistent with sustained fire sequence.

In frame f13 (46.5s), a small bright flash and smoke plume appear on the ground left of center; by f14 (47.0s), the flash has expanded into a visible fireball and debris cloud—indicative of a small explosion (e.g., grenade or IED).
In frame f14 (47.0s), a second distinct muzzle flash appears near the center-left of the street; persists into f15 (47.5s) as a sustained bright spot with smoke, confirming ongoing gunfire.

Soldiers in a dim, enclosed space are actively aiming and firing rifles; muzzle flashes and weapon recoil are visible across frames f0–f5, particularly in f4–f5 where the foreground soldier’s rifle is raised and his expression indicates active engagement.
A bright flash and rapidly expanding smoke plume in the background suggest a small explosion or detonation near burning debris, distinct from the steady fires seen earlier.

A sudden, bright flash and rapidly expanding fireball occur in the background at ~58.0s (f12), consistent with an explosion; subsequent frames (f13–f15) show the fireball persisting and smoke billowing, indicating a detonation event rather than sustained burning.
A sudden bright flash and rapidly expanding fireball erupts from a low object on the ground, consistent with an explosion (e.g., grenade or IED), distinct from sustained burning.
A soldier in the center of the frame is actively firing a rifle, with a visible muzzle flash and recoil motion; other armed figures are positioned nearby, suggesting coordinated fire.
A large, sudden fireball erupts near the center of the frame, illuminating surrounding soldiers and vehicles—consistent with an explosion (e.g., grenade or IED), distinct from sustained gunfire.

Over-the-shoulder view shows a person aiming and firing a rifle; a bright muzzle flash is visible at the barrel tip in frame f15, confirming active discharge.; Over-the-shoulder view shows a soldier firing a rifle with visible muzzle flash and tracer-like light; background includes burning wreckage and other armed personnel.; Silhouetted soldier in foreground aims and fires a weapon; bright muzzle flash visible against dark, smoke-filled urban backdrop with damaged vehicles and structures.
The wounded man struggles upward while being held by multiple assailants; physical resistance and active restraint suggest mutual combat or violent struggle during the assault.
Intense mounted melee combat involving armored knights with swords and lances; horses rearing, riders clashing, and weapons crossing in close-quarters battle.
Intense melee combat between mounted and foot soldiers in a large-scale battle; individuals are actively striking, clashing weapons, and engaging in close-quarters physical struggle.
Large-scale melee combat between two armies on a grassy field, with soldiers wielding swords, shields, and spears; visible clashing, striking, and close-quarters engagement throughout the sequence.

Intense melee combat between two groups of warriors on a grassy field; individuals are engaged in sword, axe, and shield fighting with visible motion blur indicating rapid movement and physical contact.
A prolonged melee combat sequence involving multiple armed individuals in a battlefield setting, with visible sword strikes, grappling, and defensive maneuvers.
A chaotic melee battle between mounted knights and foot soldiers on a grassy field, involving sword strikes, grappling, and close-quarters combat.

A mounted warrior with long hair and a scarf wields two swords in an aggressive charge toward armored opponents; visible combat motion includes swinging weapons and evasive reactions from adversaries.; The same warrior is seen dismounting or being thrown from his horse while still engaged, with close proximity to enemy combatants and visible weapon contact or near-contact.
An armored opponent wearing a studded helmet and chainmail is shown reacting to an attack—head turned sharply upward, mouth open in exertion or pain—indicating active engagement in melee combat.

A warrior with long hair and face paint engages in close-quarters combat with an armored opponent, swinging a weapon and making contact.; The same warrior is shown delivering a decisive blow, causing the opponent to fall to the ground; motion blur indicates rapid impact.
Another combatant (with blue face paint) is engaged in active fighting, wielding an axe amid surrounding chaos; visible motion and proximity suggest ongoing mutual combat.

Intense melee combat between Scottish warriors (including one with blue face paint) and English soldiers in chainmail and surcoats, involving swords, spears, and cavalry charges on a grassy battlefield.
Close-quarters melee combat between two armored fighters: one with chainmail and a black coif, the other (William Wallace) with face paint and leather armor, exchanging sword strikes.
Large-scale melee combat between two armed groups in a foggy field; individuals are actively swinging swords, axes, and spears, with visible blood and close physical engagement.

A wounded man (William Wallace) is on the ground, visibly injured with blood on his face and arms, gripping a weapon while surrounded by fallen combatants and active fighters in the background; he appears to be engaged in close-quarters combat or resisting an attack.

A wounded man with long hair and blood on his face is engaged in close combat; he is struck or grapples with an opponent wearing segmented armor, visible in frames f0–f2, with motion blur indicating violent struggle in f3.
A figure in armor swings a weapon (possibly a mace or axe) downward toward a prone or falling opponent; the motion is captured in frames f7–f8, with impact and follow-through evident in f9.

A man with a sword attacks another combatant who is already down or heavily injured; the attacker is mid-swing in f13, and the victim is seen lying with visible wounds in f14–f15, confirming active melee engagement.
Cavalry and infantry engage in close combat on a grassy field; horses charge, riders wield weapons, and figures are seen clashing in melee.

Intense close-quarters combat in a chaotic battlefield setting, with visible blood on the central figure, blurred motion indicating rapid movement and strikes, and multiple armed combatants engaged around him.
A warrior in segmented armor is on the ground, being engaged by another combatant; visible motion blur and proximity suggest active hand-to-hand combat or a takedown.

A long-haired man (William Wallace) is shown in close-up, bloodied and shouting while mounted on horseback, actively engaged in melee combat; his posture and facial expression indicate intense fighting.; Close-up of a man on horseback engaged in physical struggle or combat, with blurred motion suggesting active engagement.
Large, rapidly expanding fireball with turbulent flame front and dark silhouettes behind it, consistent with an explosion rather than sustained fire.
Intense, rapidly expanding orange-yellow fireball with turbulent motion, consistent with a large explosion or detonation; appears at the start of the sequence before the battle scene resolves.
Clear medium shot of a bloodied man in armor amid a chaotic melee; background shows multiple figures wielding weapons and clashing—direct visual evidence of mutual physical combat.
Close-up and mid-range shots show individuals in direct physical combat: one man with blood and a cross painted on his face is actively engaged, surrounded by others wielding weapons and clashing.

A mounted knight on a brown horse rears up aggressively toward another knight on a dark horse, initiating a physical confrontation; the horses are close and the posture suggests imminent or ongoing combat.

Two knights on horseback engage in direct combat: one raises a mace-like weapon and swings it downward toward the other, who is seated and appears to be bracing or reacting; the motion and proximity confirm active melee fighting.
A mounted knight in full armor with a lance engages in combat with a warrior (William Wallace) on horseback wielding a sword; the sequence shows charging, clashing, and pursuit across an open field.

Two mounted warriors engage in a high-speed cavalry duel: one (William Wallace) wields a sword, the other (a knight in white surcoat and helmet) wields a lance; they charge, clash, and the knight is struck and thrown from his horse.
A mounted warrior is violently thrown from his horse during a combat maneuver; the motion blur and body position indicate a forceful dismount likely caused by an opponent's strike or evasive action.
The fallen knight lies on the ground while the victor (Wallace) rides away; the knight’s weapon (sword) is seen embedded in the ground near him, indicating the conclusion of the combat.

A man with long hair (William Wallace) engages in close-quarters combat with a knight, grabbing the knight’s helmet and pulling him down, then subduing him on the ground while holding a sword to his throat.
A man in a dark shirt points a golden handgun directly at another person; the gun is held steady and aimed, consistent with an imminent or ongoing shooting action.
A gun is fired, evidenced by a bright muzzle flash visible in the dark room at frame f13 (13.5s), immediately followed by a person falling to the floor in frame f14 (14.0s).
A man in a dark suit initiates a physical confrontation, lunging and grappling with an opponent; visible hand-to-hand combat including grabbing and close-quarters struggle.
Sustained multi-opponent hand-to-hand combat: the main subject engages multiple attackers simultaneously using strikes, takedowns, and defensive maneuvers in a confined lab-like space.

Two men are engaged in close-quarters hand-to-hand combat; one man is grabbing the other's head/neck while the other defends with raised fists.; One man swings a wooden object (likely a bat or pipe) at another man who is ducking and raising his arms to block; this is a clear offensive strike in an ongoing fight.; The attacker advances while the defender is on the ground, indicating continuation of the physical confrontation; the defender appears to be recovering or evading.

The defender, now standing, grabs a wooden object and prepares to swing it; the attacker is turning toward him—this is active weapon-based combat.; Two men engage in close-quarters combat in a lab; one swings a wooden object (likely a baton or pipe) and strikes the other, producing a visible puff of smoke/dust upon impact.

The defender swings the wooden object and strikes the attacker, producing a visible cloud of smoke/dust upon impact; the attacker recoils violently.; The attacker, still reeling from the blow, is struck again or continues to be engaged; the defender follows through with the weapon amid lingering smoke/dust.
A man in a dark jacket initiates a physical confrontation, kicking and grappling with an opponent in a lab-like setting.

Two men engage in a violent hand-to-hand combat sequence in a laboratory-like setting, involving punches, kicks, throws, and use of a wooden object as a weapon; the fight progresses dynamically across multiple frames with clear mutual engagement.
Two men engage in close-quarters hand-to-hand combat: one initiates a strike, the other evades and counters with a takedown, culminating in one man being thrown onto a table and falling to the floor.

After regaining footing, the first man grabs a glass container and smashes it on the second man’s head, causing a visible burst of liquid/vapor; the second man reacts in pain while the first stands over him.

Two men engage in a sustained, mutual physical fight in an industrial room with large metal tanks. The sequence shows grappling, striking, defensive blocks, and dynamic movement around the environment, including one man being thrown or stumbling against a tank (f15). Both participants actively resist and counterattack throughout.
A man with facial tattoos aggressively confronts another man, grabbing his arm and leaning in close; the interaction escalates to physical contact and apparent struggle.
The two men engage in a physical struggle outside the vehicle; the tattooed man is pushed back and appears to be struck or shoved.

After the impact, the man in the driver’s seat (Paul Walker) takes control of the van, with hands on the wheel while handcuffed, suggesting he overpowered the attacker and is now driving away amid ongoing conflict.

A multi-person physical fight unfolds in an alley with graffiti-covered vehicles; the main subject (man in grey t-shirt) engages in hand-to-hand combat with multiple attackers wearing hoodies and caps, using punches, kicks, and improvised weapons (e.g., metal pipe), while others grapple and strike around him.

A multi-person physical fight occurs in an alley with graffiti-covered cars; the main protagonist (gray shirt) engages multiple attackers using hand-to-hand combat and improvised weapons (e.g., a metal pipe), including striking, kicking, and throwing opponents against vehicles.; A sustained multi-person physical fight involving a man in a grey t-shirt using a steering wheel as a weapon against several attackers in an alley; includes striking, grappling, and one opponent being thrown into a van.

A multi-person physical fight occurs in an alley with graffiti-covered cars; participants use improvised weapons including a steering wheel and a metal bar, with grappling, striking, and takedowns observed across the sequence.

A man in a grey t-shirt engages in physical combat with two opponents: one wearing a yellow vest and black pants, and another older man in a black jacket and white cap. The fight involves grappling, throwing, and ground impact, with dust kicked up during the struggle.
A man in a grey shirt engages in a physical fight with two opponents near a van; he throws one opponent (wearing a red/white cap) to the ground, who then lies on the dusty ground.

The man in grey tackles or throws the opponent in black and white cap, who falls heavily onto the dusty ground, sliding and rolling while raising his arms. This is a continuation of the earlier combat sequence.
A bald man points a silver handgun directly at the man in the grey shirt; the gun is clearly visible and aimed, constituting visual evidence of an imminent or ongoing shooting.
After the gun is drawn, the man in the grey shirt disarms or blocks the shooter and they grapple closely beside the van, indicating continued physical combat.
A man in the foreground is holding a firearm and aiming it forward; other armed individuals are visible behind him in a tense standoff, consistent with an active shooting situation.
Multiple armed individuals fire automatic weapons toward the yellow bus; visible muzzle flashes and bullet impacts on the bus are present.
A group of armed men fire automatic weapons in a coordinated volley; muzzle flashes and smoke are visible from multiple firearms.

Continued gunfire against the bus; bullet holes appear on the bus exterior, smoke and sparks visible from impacts; interior view shows sparks flying inside from incoming rounds.; Intense gunfire inside the bus, with sparks and debris flying as bullets strike interior surfaces; visible through windows and open door.
Continued sustained shooting by multiple individuals outside; muzzle flashes, spent casings on ground, and bullet impacts on bus exterior confirm active gunfire.

A man in a black tank top is holding a firearm and appears to be firing, with motion blur suggesting rapid action; smoke and debris visible near a yellow vehicle in subsequent frames suggest impact or discharge.

Close-up of three men holding and aiming assault rifles; one man’s weapon shows clear muzzle flash in f14, confirming active firing.; Multiple armed individuals (at least four) are aiming assault rifles in a coordinated manner; bullet holes appear on the yellow bus windows in later frames (f8–f10), confirming active gunfire directed at the vehicle.
A person in a hooded jacket is visibly aiming and firing a handgun; muzzle flash or recoil is implied by posture and weapon orientation in frames f3–f5.

Multiple individuals in the armed group are holding rifles in ready-to-fire positions; one individual in foreground (f8–f9) appears to be actively aiming/engaging, though no muzzle flash is visible. Given context and posture, shooting is highly probable during this interval.
A person is seen holding and aiming a rifle inside a bus; muzzle flash or recoil is not visible, but the posture and weapon handling strongly suggest an imminent or ongoing shooting action.

Two individuals are in close proximity inside the bus, one holding a rifle while the other appears to be grappling or restraining from behind; physical contact and tension suggest mutual combat or struggle.

A man in a white shirt engages in close-quarters hand-to-hand combat with an opponent holding a knife; the sequence shows grappling, striking, and the knife being used or threatened, culminating in the opponent receiving facial trauma.; A sustained multi-person physical fight in a dimly lit, cluttered indoor space. One man in a white tank top (later revealed with a red stain on his chest) engages multiple opponents using punches, kicks, and improvised weapons (e.g., a metal rod). The combat is dynamic and mutual, with participants actively attacking and defending.
The same man in the white shirt fights multiple opponents in a cluttered indoor space, using kicks and strikes; at least two adversaries are visibly engaged and one is knocked down.

A multi-person melee fight occurs in a dimly lit workshop; one man in a white tank top actively engages multiple opponents with hand-to-hand combat and improvised weapons, while another man in a brown jacket is knocked to the ground and remains incapacitated.

A man in a white tank top engages in close-quarters hand-to-hand combat with an opponent, delivering rapid punches and blocks in a cluttered workshop setting.; The same man in the white shirt uses a fiery forge or molten metal as part of the fight, striking an opponent who is thrown backward through sparks and smoke near the fire source.; The fight continues with dynamic acrobatic maneuvers: the protagonist climbs scaffolding while being attacked, then counters with kicks and grappling on elevated platforms, culminating in a close-range struggle near a red support pole.; A man in a white shirt engages in close-quarters combat with an opponent, delivering multiple strikes including a high kick and a downward strike with a wooden object, resulting in the opponent being knocked down amidst sparks and fire.

A man in dark clothing performs an acrobatic leap over a red altar while another person is visible on a platform above; the motion and context suggest a choreographed fight sequence.; The man in the white shirt is seen moving rapidly through the cluttered space, engaging or evading multiple opponents in a chaotic melee; background figures are also fighting, suggesting ongoing group combat.; Two men engage in close-quarters combat: one in a white shirt executes a high kick that connects with the opponent, who is thrown backward into a burning barrel, causing flames to erupt around him.

The same man in the white shirt performs an acrobatic leap from a high platform onto a lower area where adversaries are present, indicating a continuation of the fight sequence in a multi-level environment.
A man in a white tank top wields a long metal pipe as a weapon and swings it at an opponent in a brown jacket; sparks fly upon impact, indicating a forceful strike in a melee exchange.
Two men engage in close-quarters physical combat; one is heavily bloodied (visible on face and chest in f0–f1) and struck repeatedly, including a visible punch to the face at f7.
Two men engage in close-quarters hand-to-hand combat: the man in white throws a punch while the man in brown blocks and counters; they grapple and lift each other off the ground.
The protagonist grabs a hanging chain and lifts an opponent off the ground in a dynamic aerial takedown, demonstrating active combat engagement.

The man in white executes a high kick or throw, launching the man in brown into the air; the airborne motion is captured across frames as he flips mid-air before impact.; The opponent is thrown through the air (f12–f13), lands hard on the floor (f14), and the protagonist collapses afterward (f15), consistent with the aftermath of intense mutual combat.; Two men engage in close-quarters physical combat in a dusty industrial space; one man (in white shirt) is on the ground, grappling and striking the other (in brown jacket), who is also downed and bleeding.
A large, sudden explosion with fireball and dense smoke erupts, throwing debris and obscuring the scene; people are visible near the blast zone.

A sudden bright flash and expanding white smoke/cloud erupts behind the female character in frame f14–f15, consistent with a small explosive device detonating (e.g., a flashbang or grenade). The rapid onset and volumetric expansion distinguish it from sustained fire or smoke deployment.
Close-up physical scuffling among several young men in white shirts, including grabbing, pushing, and one man smiling during the struggle—indicating mutual engagement rather than one-sided attack.
Soldiers in helmets and uniforms are actively firing rifles; visible muzzle flash and smoke from multiple weapons confirm active shooting.

Multiple instances of mutual physical combat: a man in a light shirt grapples with others (f1, f3, f8–f10, f12–f15); a uniformed officer strikes a civilian with a baton while being resisted (f13–f15); individuals exchange punches and holds in close quarters.

Direct mutual physical combat between at least two pairs: one man in beige shirt grapples with a woman while being pulled/struck; another man in white shirt is actively punching or striking a man in green uniform holding a baton (visible in f5–f7).

Mutual physical combat is evident between at least two men in light shirts and the woman, with grappling, pulling, and forceful embraces indicating active struggle; the man behind the woman appears to be restraining or fighting her while she resists.

Multiple instances of mutual physical combat: soldiers and civilians are seen grabbing, striking, and wrestling each other; e.g., soldier in helmet grappling with civilian in white shirt (f0, f1), civilians being struck and falling (f9–f13).

Close-up of a person holding an M16-style rifle with visible muzzle flash/smoke at the barrel tip (f6–f8), indicating discharge; background shows outdoor setting with building and power lines, consistent with live firing.; A rifle is shown firing, with visible muzzle flash and smoke at the barrel tip, indicating active discharge.

Multiple individuals engaged in close physical struggle against a wall; one person is being restrained or shoved forcefully by others, with visible resistance and tension.; A man in a white shirt is seen actively grappling with and restraining a woman against a wall; other individuals surround them, with physical contact and struggle evident across multiple frames.

Two rifles are visibly aimed directly at the man in the brown jacket, with barrels pointed at his head/upper torso, indicating an imminent or ongoing shooting threat; the guns are held steady and aligned for firing.
Muzzle flash visible from an AK-47 held by the man in the brown jacket (frame f8), indicating active gunfire during that interval; corroborated by similar flash in f9.
A soldier in green uniform is seen firing a rifle from behind a straw berm; muzzle flash and recoil are visible in frames f3–f8, indicating active gunfire.
A man in a dark jacket is shown aiming and firing a handgun; muzzle flash is visible at the barrel tip.
A bright, sudden flash and expanding fireball with smoke erupts on the right side of the frame, consistent with an explosion.

A bright muzzle flash erupts from the driver's side of the white Mercedes (license plate AM16) as it fires toward the other vehicle; a hand holding a pistol is visible in the driver’s window in frame f12 and f13, with intense flash obscuring the scene in f13–f15.

A sudden, intense explosion erupts behind and to the right of a dark sedan, producing a bright fireball, flying debris, and violently launching another vehicle (appearing as a truck or van chassis) into the air; visible in frames showing the initial blast and its immediate aftermath.

A large secondary explosion engulfs the scene, generating a massive yellow-white fireball and dense smoke plume; a derrick-like structure is visible in the background, confirming an industrial/oil-field setting; the explosion propagates outward and consumes the damaged sedan.
A large, sudden fireball erupts from the burning car, violently propelling the person backward into the air in a classic explosion blast wave.
A large, bright yellow-orange explosion erupts in the background, with visible fireball expansion and debris/sparks flying upward; the person is thrown backward by the blast wave.
